description: A single line drawn as horizontal steps, holding each value until the next reading.
overview: A single line drawn as flat steps that hold each value until the next reading. It fits values that change in discrete jumps, like prices, plan tiers or headcount.
usage: Replace `chartData`, point each `dataKey` at your fields and set the label and color in `chartConfig`. Use `stepAfter` or `stepBefore` as the curve type to move where each jump happens.
notes: The tooltip follows the cursor, or the arrow keys once the chart has focus.
